dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you looking to buy some stuff from Dori?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hehehe, quite the opposite. I am her supplier.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Nicole came up with a delightful new pricing method recently, which I've asked dear Dori to try out. We're here today to see how it's all going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What sort of pricing method is that?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Curious? Well, allow me to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Instead of an amount of Mora, you collect "courage," "kindness," or "happiness" from the buyer.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: The key is to make people realize they don't have to be rich. With an excellence of character, even the treasures of the Hexenzirkel are within your reach.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Kinda like... a Seelie guiding intrepid adventurers through various tribulations until they claim their prize. Such fun, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Not for me. We didn't sell much Hexenzirkel gear this time at all. At this point, I'll have to whip out some Sumeru specialties just to break even...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you're actually losing money, Dori?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You're saying our gifts didn't reach that many people?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I'm saying... we made diddly-squat. Hate to break it to you, Miss Mage, but you don't have much of a head for business.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Oh, it might not have made much, but this has been quite a fun little experiment. To make it up to you, all the revenue from our merchandise is yours to keep, Dori.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Oho! They don't call you a Great Mage for nothing, Miss Alice!
